transcript_tail.text: Review all dumps and review videos on the public.

Public repo audit — all clean.

**Dumps in the public repo (jdtogni78/FamilyFund main):**

7 tracked `.sql` files, **0 family-emails-list matches in any of them**:

| File | Lines | Purpose | PII |
|---|---|---|---|
| `database/familyfund_ddl.sql` | 576 | DDL only | 0 |
| `database/familyfund_ddl_20220806.sql` | 576 | DDL snapshot | 0 |
| `database/familyfund_ddl_20260110.sql` | 858 | DDL snapshot | 0 |
| `database/prod_to_dev.sql` | 334 | anonymization script (just hardened) | 0 |
| `database/truncate_all.sql` | 38 | utility | 0 |
| `database/drop_all.sql` | 38 | utility | 0 |
| `database/delete_test_data.sql` | 15 | utility | 0 |

Only INSERT in any of them is the synthetic `claude@test.local` row in `prod_to_dev.sql`. The 2.3 MB raw prod data dump (`database/dev/familyfund_dev_data_20260419.sql`) is gitignored — not in the public repo.

**Videos in the public repo:**

**Zero video files tracked.** `demos/.gitignore` excludes `out/` and `**/.narrate/`, so all rendered `.mp4`s are local-only. The repo carries only the 12 demo **script** YAMLs (`demos/*.demo.yaml`) — text instructions for the narrate tool, not the renders themselves.

The 5 currently-rendered videos sit in `.claude/worktrees/sweet-driscoll-0b292c/demos/out/` (admin/trading-config/funds-accounts/account/funds.mp4) — local to the demo-rendering session's worktree. They were rendered **before** today's scrub, so they still contain the pre-scrub PII; that's exactly why the demo session said they'd re-render. Once they do, the new renders will be clean (DB scrubbed, on-disk emails wiped, MAIL_FROM updated).

**Name-fragment matches in docs (intentional, not PII):**

15 markdown files contain `togni` etc., but every hit is either:
- the user's **public** GitHub handle `jdtogni78` in URLs/clone commands (SETUP.md, AGENTS.md, etc.), or
- the **documented scrub regex** in security/incident docs (HISTORY-AUDIT-66.md, SECURITY-EXPOSURE.md), which intentionally records that `jdtogni@gmail.com → admin@dev.familyfund.local` was the rewrite rule used in the 2026-05-25 history purge.

Both are public/intentional and not changes to make.

**Net:** Public repo is clean — no dumps with PII, no videos at all. The only remaining attack surface for accidental publication is the demo-rendering session's local `.mp4`s, which will be replaced by post-scrub renders.
Now the second one should be moved to The Secrets and should not be on the public.
I want to make sure I move the right thing — "the second one" could mean a couple of things in my recent messages. Let me ask.
